つい.en: to take (seat, position, course, office, etc.)

次.en: to pass on (a message, thoughts, etc.)

ちょう.en: counter for long and narrow things (e.g. guns, spades, hoes, oars, ink sticks, candles, abacuses, kitchen knives, scissors, shamisen, violins)

かなう.en: to come true (of a dream, wish, etc.)

だし.en: to take out; to put out; auxiliary suggestion
